title: PayU: Remove the email field while retaining the phone number.

change.control: Payment checkout requires both phone number and email.
change.variant: Remove the email field while retaining the phone number.

significance.reported: Statistically significant improvement reported; confidence threshold not published.

quote: The results demonstrated that dropping the email field showed a statistically significant improvement of 5.8% compared to the control.
notes: Body gives 5.8%; headline rounds to 6%. The test concerns merchant payment users, not PayU merchant signup. Legal receipt requirements are context specific.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
